capabilities: detect GitHub repository URLs in notes
display star counts inline next to links in Reading View and Live Preview
embed star counts into Markdown files and remove them again
cache star counts and refresh them per note or vault-wide
format counts as full or abbreviated numbers (1.2k)
extras: Works without a token but limited to 60 GitHub API requests per hour; token raises this to 5,000 per hour and triggers token-missing warnings during manual refresh.
problem: Obsidian renders GitHub repository links as plain text, so readers cannot see a repository's popularity without opening the link.

relations.evidence: It fetches fresh star counts from GitHub for every repository in the active note

summary: Link enhancer that shows GitHub star counts next to repository URLs in Reading View and Live Preview and can write them into Markdown.
